summary: Healer archetype: Protection School abilities give double the uses; may not purchase Death, Command or Subdual School abilities.

effects.subject: bearer

params.scope: all abilities purchased in the Protection School

effects.note: Example: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3; 2/Life becomes 4/Life.

effects.subject: bearer

params.scope: any abilities from the Death, Command, or Subdual Schools

effects.note: Drawback: may not purchase Death, Command or Subdual School abilities.

clarifications.text: Worked example of doubling: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3, and 2/Life becomes 4/Life.
